children: Strategy announced a raise in its digital credit securities repurchase authorization to $2.0 billion and reported bitcoin and cash balances.
Board increased Digital Credit Securities Repurchase Program authorization from $1.0B to $2.0B, inclusive of fees and prior repurchases.
As of Sept 7, 2026, Strategy holds ~845,050 bitcoin acquired for $63.73B total, avg cost ~$75,412 per bitcoin (incl. fees).
From Aug 31–Sept 7, 2026, Strategy repurchased 1,810,885 shares of STRC preferred stock for $176.3M using USD Cash.
As of Sept 7, 2026, USD Reserve totaled $5.10B and USD Cash totaled $1.44B; $1.19B remained available under the preferred repurchase program.
